#### What this PR does / why we need it:
Optimize GetAgnHostImage func used in e2e tests by following the pattern established in GetSparkTestImage func.

#### Which issue(s) this PR fixes:
GetAgnHostImage opens and parses the agnhost Dockerfile from disk on every call, whereas GetSparkTestImage already wraps the equivalent lookup in a sync.Once so the image is resolved only once and cached for reuse. Aligning GetAgnHostImage with that pattern avoids repeated file I/O and parsing across e2e test runs and keeps the two image-resolution helpers consistent and easier to maintain.

<summary>📝 Walkthrough</summary>

## Walkthrough

This PR optimizes E2E test image resolution by adding sync.Once-based caching to the Docker image lookup functions. The changes add cache state variables and introduce a shared `getCachedDockerImage` helper to compute images exactly once, preferring environment variables and falling back to Dockerfile parsing, avoiding repeated file I/O and parsing on subsequent calls.

## Changes

**E2E Docker Image Caching**

| Layer / File(s) | Summary |
|---|---|
| **Image caching with sync.Once** <br> `test/util/e2e.go`, `test/util/constants.go` | Adds `sync` import and introduces agnhost image cache state variables (`agnHostImageOnce`, `agnHostImage`) alongside existing spark image variables. Refactors `GetAgnHostImage` and `GetSparkTestImage` to use a shared `getCachedDockerImage(once, cache, envVar, dir)` helper that resolves each image once via `sync.Once`—preferring environment variables (e.g., `E2E_TEST_AGNHOST_IMAGE`) and otherwise parsing the corresponding Dockerfile under `hack/testing/<dir>/Dockerfile`—and panics on parse failures. |

## Estimated code review effort

🎯 2 (Simple) | ⏱️ ~10 minutes

## Possibly related PRs

- [kubernetes-sigs/kueue#11951](https://github.com/kubernetes-sigs/kueue/pull/11951): Both PRs refactor E2E Docker image resolution to cache computed image references using `sync.Once`, affecting the same image-lookup code paths in `GetSparkTestImage` and related helpers.
